new_suggestions.title: Keep the update toast clear of book captions and status
new_suggestions.observation: The visible toast around native x=218..400/y=635..684 overlaps the second cover row's bottom and caption/status band. Portions of the second and third book captions/status are hidden by its white rectangle.

unresolved_evidence_gaps.raw_observation: The visible book still has unread=3 and badge 3 after the captured batch-read action. The existing recorded mark-read check passes with 86 chapter records. No unread=0 expectation is asserted by this reviewer.

frozen_check_read.query: SELECT document FROM chapters WHERE book_id=?
frozen_check_read.assertion: bool(rows) and all(json.loads(row[0]).get('read') is True for row in rows)
frozen_check_read.scope: All chapter records stored for the selected book at capture time; the assertion is stronger than a read-only count but does not independently prove a complete remote catalog.

unresolved_evidence_gaps.case_boundary: demo=true; visible_books has unread=3 and a textual status naming 86 chapters, but no numeric per-book chapter_count/total or badge-source aggregation declaration. Screen-level chapter_count=0, unread_count=0 and visible_chapters=[] are not established as the library badge aggregate.
unresolved_evidence_gaps.unresolved_semantics: The frozen case/harness does not assert that the demo visible-book summary badge and stored chapter-read records share an aggregate that must update together, or that no further unmaterialized chapters exist. The matching textual 86-chapter status is evidence to retain, not a sufficient source declaration.
unresolved_evidence_gaps.next_step: Root must adjudicate the demo summary boundary and unread badge data source/aggregation intent using authoritative frozen evidence. Do not prescribe unread=0 or count this as a confirmed actionable defect before that triage.

historical_second_pass_summary.note: G36 truthful demo outcome is separate from pending toast placement. Mark-read is a raw consistency gap and does not prescribe unread=0.

owner_accounting_pending: Later owner remote byte accounting against this ledger and the final frozen inventory; no local byte/hash verification was performed.
Historical source-map SHA remains pending owner remote static accounting as declared by the regression input.

global_capture_status.scope: The zero assigned failed-frame count is confined to these 50 owner-declared cases. It is not a successful full-suite or global mechanical PASS.

report_and_original_mutation_policy: This completion authoring and its linked second-pass report do not modify any original PNG/case/state/action, prior small-batch report, production, harness, capture plan or unique findings map.
ledger_identity_boundary: All artifact hashes are owner-frozen assigned identities copied for later owner accounting. Original actual viewing is a manual observation. This ledger is not local rehash, automatic verification, a runtime PASS or design acceptance.
execution_boundary: Only static text reading, required actual original-image viewing and English JSON document authoring were used. No tests/build/probe/SQL/SSH/copy/crop/image processing or new agents.
capability_boundary: Screenshots and recorded replay/state do not qualify physical input/evdev, e-ink waveforms, sensor/pen, performance, sleep/wake or independent live-reader cache leases.
withdrawn_observation_boundary: The withdrawn V08-04 clock allegation is not inherited or reintroduced.
